title: Screening Colonoscopy
text:
Screening colonoscopy (PRC-170) is covered for members who meet age or risk criteria and for evaluation of gastrointestinal symptoms. Documentation must include the indication, the findings of the procedure, and the follow-up plan.

The procedure must be billed with a gastrointestinal or screening diagnosis. Because of the higher cost of the procedure, claims above the auto-approval limit are sent to review.
